apps.name: Ordinero Business
apps.subtitle: Your restaurant tonight
apps.localizedDescription: Tonight’s tables, bills and menu for Ordinero restaurant owners.
apps.versionDescription: The app now follows each person's role at the store. Waiters and floor staff get a new Service tab with the live queue, a read-only Menu and More, while owners and managers keep everything and also get Service. More has a new look, with your language, account details and store hours all editable from the phone.
